title: Solving Redis Cluster Cross-Slot Errors with Hash Tags
prompt: Your payments service is migrating from standalone Redis to a 6-node Redis Cluster (3 primaries, 3 replicas, 16,384 hash slots). Two core workflows immediately fail with `CROSSSLOT Keys in request don't hash to the same slot`: (1) an atomic Lua transfer/ledger script touching `user:1042:balance`, `user:1042:ledger`, and `user:1042:nonce`, and (2) a batch dashboard read calling `MGET` across 50 different users (`user:101:profile ... user:150:profile`). Redesign key naming, Lua execution, and client batching so both workflows succeed with < 2ms p99 latency and zero hot-shard skew.

spark.summary: Migrating multi-key MGET, MULTI/EXEC, or Lua scripts to a 16,384-slot Redis Cluster fails with CROSSSLOT errors whenever keys hash to different shard primaries.
spark.keyTakeaway: When a single bottleneck threatens end-to-end availability, colocate strictly atomic entity keys on one slot using `{hash_tags}` (e.g., `{user:1042}:balance`), and replace cross-entity MGET/MSET with slot-grouped parallel scatter-gather pipelines.
spark.byteSummary:
**Core Mechanics:** Redis Cluster partitions the keyspace into `16,384` hash slots (`CRC16(key) & 16383`) across 3 primaries (`0–5460`, `5461–10922`, `10923–16383`) with no distributed two-phase commit.

**Visual & Structural Flow:** Depicts Untagged Keys Scatter Across Shards and Fail Lua/MGET (Payments Svc -> Primary 1 (0..5460) -> Primary 2 (5461..10922)); Fine-Grained {user:1042} Colocation Across 3 Primaries (P1 -> P2 -> P3 -> R1..3 -> 0..5460).

**Trade-Offs & Production:** Wrapping a static prefix in braces—such as `{payments}:user:1042:balance`—forces Redis Cluster to hash only `"payments"` for **every key in the system**. Solve both atomic per-entity scripts and cross-entity batches cleanly: **Entity-Scoped `{hash_tags}`**: Name keys `{user:1042}:balance`, `{user:1042}:ledger`, and `{user:1042}:nonce`.

**Failure Modes & Application:** Slot-aware key design is foundational when scaling Redis Cluster: **Rate Limiters & Sliding Windows**: Colocate `{tenant:42}:tokens` and `{tenant:42}:ts` for atomic Lua token-bucket updates.
